2014_spells.longstrider.description: You touch a creature. The target's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.
2014_spells.longstrider.effectSummary: Change a target: the target's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends
2014_spells.longstrider.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you touch a creature. The target's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends; When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each spell slot above 1st. The target's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.
